examples: pm brex unlock card apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: immediately re-enables new transactions on a previously locked card
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update card reverse-ETL action
examples: pm brex update card apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing card's spend controls (limit amount/category/merchant restrictions); takes effect on the physical/virtual card immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update expense reverse-ETL action
examples: pm brex update expense apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing card expense's memo; low-risk metadata-only external mutation
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm brex update user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing user's status, manager, department, location, or title; setting status to a terminated/suspended state revokes account access
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update vendor reverse-ETL action
examples: pm brex update vendor apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing vendor's name, contact details, or payment accounts; affects future transfer counterparty resolution
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm brex update webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: re-points an already-registered webhook's delivery URL, event set, or active status; redirects live event delivery immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
